The session took seven upstream engine commits, cherry-picked as one measured patch: reversed scroll origins measured against Taffy's scrollable overflow, hit testing of elements that have no computed styles yet, and five Taffy bumps.
The Taffy engine pin moved from e90751fd to a3997d55, version 0.15.0 and features unchanged, still the one git source.
Every document now has a reversed box (RTL, row-reverse, column-reverse, wrap-reverse) scroll to negative offsets; scroll width and height answer the CSSOM scroll size; the founder ratified this behaviour change.
The engine's scroll state reads a current, minimum and maximum offset; programmatic scroll clamps between them; scroll into view skips a box whose minimum and maximum are both zero.
The hit test's clip stop on a clipping inline root now answers in content-box coordinates, the frame the final self hit and text hits answer in; which node is hit and whether a hit happens are unchanged; a node with no computed styles is never a scroll container, closing a select popup panic.
Gates green: test tally 1501 to 1511, agent-run run all 845 to 851, the a11y leg unmoved at 14 · 115 · 0, stand-repeat 3 of 3 rounds green, CI green 17/17; no node key, verb, cause, event or log field added.

body: A rule over the engine's hit testing (an inert element takes no hit, the hit-testing contract for inert): the hit test's content check now reads the overflow rect's four sides plus the client offset, and the clip stop on a clipping inline root answers in content-box coordinates; the node hit is unchanged.
The driver click refusal for a covered target and a driver click in a shown scrollbar band: both read the engine's hit test and scrollbar band, whose scroll range is now signed for a reversed box.
A rule over default scrollbar thumbs (their contrast stroke, a near-white author thumb's visible state change): the thumb now runs over the signed scroll range of a reversed scroller.

Snapshot bounds of a closed select's options, an open list's rows and a multiple select's rows and groups, and the lint contrast finding's bounds: all read layout geometry that moved with five Taffy bumps and reversed origins; the chunk holds escher's bounds, hit and into-view readings.
The synthetic click at a node's centre and the driver actions: they read node bounds and the hit test the take changed.

The single select's engine overlay list: a node with no computed styles is now never a scroll container, the seam that closes a select popup panic under the workspace's features, and an element with no computed styles yet can be hit.
Open select list rows of one height and the select list without motion: the list's scrolling now clamps between a minimum and a maximum offset, and scroll into view skips a box with no scroll range.

Hidpi or zoom change reshaping text and the stand reading no lint finding at boot: inline and text layout moved with the Taffy bumps (float insets, zero-height float segments, collapse-through margins, replaced min-content); the a11y and stand legs stayed green.
The a11y CI leg and the accessibility checks gating CI: the adapter probe re-read on the lock move, its tally 14 · 115 · 0 unmoved; where a row holds that tally it stands.
Stand checks repeated three rounds: stand-repeat 3 of 3 rounds green, its tally 258 · 1380 · 0 · 24 unmoved.
The engine dependency the accessibility tree is laid out over: the Taffy pin moved from e90751fd to a3997d55, where an a11y-plan row names the engine pin.
ARIA role mapping, accessible name precedence, ARIA state and property reads and hidden-content exclusion: no role, name, state or attribute read changed.
Keyboard navigation contracts: range input keys, single and multiple select keys, the Cells grid, the CRUD list, Tab order and keyboard activation are unchanged.
Focus rules: what is focusable, focus fixup, focus-visible, inert exclusion from focus and focus on removal are unchanged.
The snapshot text form, state tokens, the snapshot diff, the actions answer, MCP tool results, served node ids and the UI graph: no node key, field, cause or verb was added.
The AccessKit adapter, its creation order, the platform adapter choice and the accessibility feature defaults: no feature or adapter changed.
WCAG contrast thresholds, the contrast ratio helper, the stand accent colour and the stand's contrast assertions: no colour or ratio moved.
Cognitive accessibility, password masking and the obs log format: the take adds no log site, span or field.

The session took upstream Blitz past #1372 by seven cherry-picks: reversed scroll origins on Taffy's ScrollableOverflow, hit testing of elements with no computed styles yet, and five Taffy bumps.
Taffy moved from git rev e90751fd to upstream main rev a3997d55, version 0.15.0 and features unchanged; it is still the workspace's one git source.
Behaviour change for every document, remote pages included: a reversed box (RTL, row-reverse, column-reverse, wrap-reverse) now scrolls to negative offsets; the founder ratified it for this take.
The scroll state became a current with a min and a max; the programmatic scroll clamps between them; scroll into view skips a box whose min and max are both zero; scrollWidth and scrollHeight answer the CSSOM scroll size.
The hit walk's clip stop now answers in the content-box frame, as the final self hit and the text hits do, resolving the textual conflict between upstream's hit hunk and the non-invertible-transform answer; Node gained a public read-only layout-data accessor.
Escher's own-scroll rule for client geometry was kept against upstream's scroll-shifted form; the Dioxus mounted-data scroll size stays on Taffy's extent; no verb, carrier, log field, span or name was added.

body: decision/deferred-upstream-dependency-bumps: the Taffy deferral ended; Taffy is taken from #1372 on at a3997d55, so the row's Taffy clause is stale (Stylo and Dioxus untouched).
decision/upstream-take-engine-changes: this take adds an engine behaviour change, reversed scroll origins scrolling to negative offsets, plus hit testing of unstyled elements.
decision/upstream-behaviour-changes-ratified-per-take: the reversed-origin change was ratified for this take by the founder.
decision/upstream-taken-by-cherry-pick and decision/upstream-sync-merge-base: seven upstream commits taken by cherry-pick with their trailers; a carried hit-hunk conflict is now resolved.
decision/no-git-dependencies and decision/taffy-layout: Taffy stays the one git source, its pinned revision moved e90751fd to a3997d55; any row holding that pin value is stale.
decision/hit-stops-at-paint-clip and decision/hit-stops-at-clip-padding-box: the clip stop's early answer now reads in the content-box frame; only an inline root's answer moves.

contract/scroll-hit/hit-clip, contract/scroll-hit/hit-with-scrollbar and contract/scroll-hit/hit-dropped-node: the hit walk's content test takes upstream's form over the overflow rect's four sides; elements with no computed styles yet are hit tested.
decision/non-invertible-transform-takes-no-hit and contract/scroll-hit/hit-degenerate-transform: the upstream hit hunk that conflicted with this answer is resolved with the answer kept.
contract/scroll-hit/scroll-into-view and decision/scroll-into-view-whole-chain: scroll into view reads the scroll state's current, min and max and skips a box whose min and max are both zero.
decision/programmatic-scroll-one-box and decision/one-scrolling-primitive: the programmatic scroll clamps between a min and a max, the min negative for a reversed box.
decision/shared-scrollbar-geometry: the scrollbar thumb runs over the signed scroll range.

decision/overflow-auto-as-scroll and decision/overflow-hidden-programmatic-only: the scroll container test now answers false for a node with no computed styles; the scrollable extent comes from Taffy's scrollable overflow.

decision/client-rect-ignores-own-scroll, decision/scrolled-box-bounds and decision/absolute-position-containing-blocks: escher's own-scroll rule kept against upstream's scroll-shifted geometry body and self match.
decision/writing-mode-off-by-default and decision/writing-mode-opt-in: the writing-mode geometry gained overflow mirroring and a scroll container argument to physical layout.
contract/layout/taffy-traits: the layout pass's cache get now takes a shared reference, as Taffy's cache trait asks.
decision/crate-internal-visibility and decision/restricted-crate-internals: blitz-dom's public API widened by one read-only Node layout-data accessor; the scroll range stays crate-internal.
decision/both-layout-modes and decision/scenarios-both-layout-modes: upstream's six reversed-origin integration tests are kept as written in one layout mode, an exception.
decision/replaced-elements: percentage-width replaced elements' min-content contributions follow Taffy's fix.
contract/wpt-attribute-tests/checklayout-attributes: the WPT runner's scroll size checks read the node's CSSOM scroll size.
decision/user-scroll-chaining and contract/dom-events/pointer-events: touch-action pan axes and user scroll read the scroll width against the client width and the signed range.
decision/resolve-before-js-geometry and decision/cssom-geometry-snapping: a page's scrollWidth and scrollHeight now answer the CSSOM scroll size, reversed origins included.
decision/layout-modes-identical and decision/deferred-inline-layout: inline layout picks up Taffy's float insets, zero-height float segments and no double counting of collapse-through margins.

A scroll state is a current with a min and a max; the programmatic scroll clamps between them and the scrollbar thumb runs over that signed range.
The hit walk's clip stop answers in the content-box frame, the frame of the final self hit and the text hits; only an inline root's answer differs from the border frame.
Elements with no computed styles yet are hit tested, and such a node is never a scroll container.
scrollWidth and scrollHeight answer the CSSOM scroll size, reversed origins included, while the Dioxus mounted-data scroll size stays on Taffy's extent.

body: The decision that hit-testing stops where paint clips (both of its twin rows): the hit stopped at an inline root's paint clip now answers in content-box coordinates, the frame of the self and text hits; the node and whether a hit happens are unchanged.

The decisions that into-view scroll is instant in nested boxes (both twin rows): into-view scroll now reads a min, max range and skips a box whose min and max are both zero; reversed boxes scroll into view at negative offsets.
The decision that driver scroll is instant: programmatic scroll now clamps between a scroll range's min and max, negative for a reversed box.
The decision on smooth scroll-behavior and wheel cancel: the smooth scroll animation reads the current offset of the new scroll state triple, its range now signed for reversed boxes.
The decision that a shown overlay scrollbar takes a pointerdown as drag, and the overlay scrollbar fade timings: the scrollbar thumb now runs over the signed scroll range.

The decision that wheel and key scroll the open select list, and the decision that a select list is an engine overlay: a node with no computed styles is never a scroll container, the fix for the select popup panic under the workspace's features.

The decisions that stacking-context roots group paint and hit-testing and that the open select list answers hits first: the hit's content test now reads the point against the overflow rect's four sides plus the client offset, and elements with no computed styles yet are hit-tested.

The snapshot contract on a row of an open select list's bounds and the screenshot verb's select list row: bounds readings were held over the take, but the bounds body now sits on Taffy's scrollable overflow.
The driver verbs click, type and press: they hit-test and scroll into view through the changed hit and scroll paths, results unchanged.

The decision that a select list is placed inside the viewport and the spacing decisions on margins and table spacing hints: the Taffy bumps stop double-counting collapse-through margins, add float insets and zero-height float segments, and change percentage-width replaced min-content contributions.

The decision on the logical viewport and the JS window inner sizes: page scrollWidth and scrollHeight now answer the CSSOM scroll size, reversed origins included, while the MountedData scroll size stays on Taffy's extent.

body_fields.fact: A reversed box (RTL, row-reverse, column-reverse, wrap-reverse) scrolls to negative offsets, its content measured against Taffy's scrollable overflow, for every document including remote pages; ratified by the founder for the take past #1372.
Programmatic scroll clamps to a scroll range of min and max, and into-view scroll skips a box whose min and max are both zero.
The overlay scrollbar thumb runs over the signed scroll range, so a reversed box's thumb starts at its negative extreme.
A hit stopped at an inline root's paint clip answers in content-box coordinates, the same frame as the final self hit and the text hits.
Elements with no computed styles yet are hit-tested before the first style resolve, and such a node is never a scroll container.

scrollWidth and scrollHeight answer the CSSOM scroll size, reversed origins included, and touch-action pan axes read scroll width over client width; the exception is MountedData's scroll size, left on Taffy's extent.

The session took seven upstream blitz commits: reversed scroll origins measured on Taffy's ScrollableOverflow, a hit test of elements with no computed styles yet, and five Taffy bumps that move the engine's Taffy git pin from e90751fd to a3997d55.
Every document's box, remote pages included, now measures its content against Taffy's scrollable overflow, so a reversed box (RTL, row-reverse, column-reverse, wrap-reverse) scrolls to negative offsets; the founder ratified this for this take.
escher's own readings were held: the scroll state now reads current, min and max, the programmatic scroll clamps between min and max, scroll-into-view skips a box whose min and max are both zero, and scrollWidth and scrollHeight answer the CSSOM scroll size.
The hit test's clip stop now answers in the content-box frame, which moves only an inline root's answer; blitz-dom gains one public read-only layout-data accessor.
No log site, span, field, event, cause, exit, endpoint or env var was added or removed; the test leg tally moved 1501 to 1511 passed and agent-run run all 845 to 851, and CI went green 17 of 17.

body: decision/engine-dependency-pins: the Taffy pin it holds moves from git rev e90751fd to a3997d55 (upstream DioxusLabs/taffy), version 0.15.0 and features unchanged — the row is stale.
decision/no-git-dependencies and decision/no-git-dependency: Taffy is still the one git source, now at rev a3997d55; any rev or exception those rows name moves with it.
decision/upstream-sync-dependency-set: the upstream take carries five Taffy bumps whole, the dependency list otherwise unchanged.

decision/locked-builds, decision/dependency-audit-ci-gate, decision/cargo-deny-audit-tool and decision/licence-gate: the lockfile's Taffy source line moved, built locked by every leg and audited green (advisories ok, licenses ok).
decision/programmatic-scroll-clamped: the programmatic scroll now clamps to the signed range (min, max), so a reversed box scrolls to negative offsets; a missing node is still ignored.

decision/select-list-scroll-own-offset: scroll into view now reads the (current, min, max) triple and skips a box whose min and max are both zero; the select list row's own-offset scroll is over that component.
decision/non-invertible-transform-no-hit: upstream's hit test hunk conflicted textually with this answer; the take resolves it and the non-invertible transform still takes no hit.

decision/visible-region-through-transforms and decision/visible-region-open-list-row: the hit test's content test now reads the overflow rect's four sides plus the client offset, and the clip stop answers content-box coordinates for an inline root; whether a hit happens and which node is unchanged.

decision/skip-snapshot-of-unstyled-node and decision/select-row-layout-none-without-styles: the hit test now reaches elements with no computed styles yet, and a node with no computed styles reads as no scroll container.

decision/stale-node-ids-never-panic and decision/no-panic-on-call-input: the select popup panic on an unstyled node under the workspace's features is closed by the scroll-container test answering false.
decision/text-extent-read-only-none-when-unresolved: a sibling read-only accessor, Node::try_layout_data, now public, answers none where no layout data stands.
decision/scrollbar-fade-on-document-clock: the scrollbar component changed — its thumb runs over the signed scroll range; the fade clock is untouched.
decision/inline-box-heights-finite: inline layout and its scrollable overflow changed with the Taffy bumps; the finite-height rule is over that component.
decision/untrusted-bytes-decoded-without-panic and decision/select-list-hostile-markup-finite: the reversed-origin behaviour change reaches every document, remote pages included.

decision/session-layout-read-in-process: scroll width and height now answer the CSSOM scroll size, reversed origins included, to every in-process reader, a page's scrollWidth and scrollHeight among them.

blitz-dom's public API carries one read-only layout accessor, Node::try_layout_data, which answers none for a node with no layout data and writes nothing.
